objective_value: <float> Total expected cost: setup costs across all facilities and periods plus probability-weighted inventory holding costs across all scenarios.
setup_variables: <dict, key: 'y_{facility}_{period}'> Whether each facility is set up to produce or order in each period (1 = set up, 0 = not), where facility 0 is the plant, facilities 1..num_warehouses are the warehouses, and facilities num_warehouses+1..num_warehouses+num_retailers are the retailers.
production_plant: <dict, key: '{period}_{scenario}'> Quantity produced at the plant in the given period under the given scenario.
delivery_warehouse: <dict, key: '{warehouse}_{period}_{scenario}'> Quantity shipped from the plant to each warehouse in the given period under the given scenario.
delivery_retailer: <dict, key: '{retailer}_{period}_{scenario}'> Quantity shipped from a warehouse to each retailer in the given period under the given scenario.
inventory_plant: <dict, key: '{period}_{scenario}'> End-of-period inventory held at the plant in the given period under the given scenario.
inventory_warehouse: <dict, key: '{warehouse}_{period}_{scenario}'> End-of-period inventory held at each warehouse in the given period under the given scenario.
inventory_retailer: <dict, key: '{retailer}_{period}_{scenario}'> End-of-period inventory held at each retailer in the given period under the given scenario.
